description: Department of Labour - The Cost Living Index Number for the month of June, 2015 applicable to workers in the Cocoa, Cardamom an Pepper growing and manufacturing trade was 181.6 and the Special Allowance payable to workers in respect of a normal working day in the month of July, 2015 is Rs. 562.98
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns the declaration of the Cost of Living Index Number and the calculation of a special allowance for workers, as mandated by the Wages Boards Ordinance. The core of the notification is the implementation of a regulatory framework (the Ordinance) to determine worker compensation, which falls under the category of legal/regulatory matters involving statutory instruments and compliance requirements. While a government official is named, the notice's primary purpose is not about the personnel change or government structure but about publishing a legally required calculation under an existing ordinance.
